data.name: Aleeyah
data.gender_notes: Aleeyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'alaa', which means 'high', 'elevated', or 'exalted'. The name Aleeyah symbolizes being lifted up to a higher plane, being sublime and majestic. The name Aleeyah carries the meaning “Exalted, sublime, lofty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Aleeyah usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, sublime, lofty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aleeyah is a spiritual name that signifies reaching for the divine, striving for higher consciousness and inner peace.
data.etymology: Aleeyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, sublime, lofty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aleeyah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: عالية
in_arabic.long_meaning: عالية هي اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من الفعل عربي علا أي ارتفع أو اسطع، ويحمل هذا الاسم معنى المكان العالي والمرتبة الرفيعة، ويرتبط بالسمو والعلو في القدر والمكانة، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التراث الإسلامي لوصف مكانة الصالحين والصديقين

in_urdu.name: علیہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: علیہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو فعل علا سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے بلندی پر چڑھنا یا چمکنا، یہ نام اسلامی روایت میں صلحاء اور صدوقین کی بلندی اور مقام کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے

in_hindi.name: अलीया
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलीया एक अरबी नाम है जो क्रिया अला से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है उच्च स्थान पर चढ़ना या चमकना, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में सलही और सदीकों की उच्चता और पद के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: عالیہ

data.cultural_impact: Aleeyah is a beautiful and noble name commonly used in the Islamic world due to its deep spiritual meaning and connection to the Quran and Hadith. Its Arabic origin and high ethical connotations have contributed to its popularity and reverence in diverse Muslim communities around the world, transcending cultural and linguistic boundaries. The name Aleeyah is often associated with the idea of striving towards excellence and the pursuit of knowledge in the pursuit of Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Aleeyah holds great spiritual significance as it instantly evokes the idea of being close to Allah and striving to live a life according to His guidance. Being 'alaa' or high and elevated in the spiritual sense means working towards profound virtues such as kindness, wisdom, and self-discipline. For Muslims, the name Aleeyah is a reminder to constantly elevate one's inner spiritual being and seek the "highest good" of Allah. The name Aleeyah is thus an affirmation of a commitment towards ethical and moral growth, emulating the lifestyle of the prophets and messengers sent by Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Aleeyah means "Exalted or Sublime" in Arabic. It symbolizes the aspiration towards spiritual heights, seeking closeness to the Divine, and striving for purity and excellence in all aspects of life.

historical_references.context: Aleeyah bint Muawiyah (d. 682 CE), also known as Umm Salamah bint Abu Huwaishah, was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). She was a wife of the Prophet and played a crucial role in the early Muslim community.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Tabari's Tarikh Al-Rusul Wa Al-Muluk The name Aleeyah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Aleeyah bint Ya'qub (d. 714 CE) was the mother of the fifth rightly-guided caliph, Al-Baqir. She was known for her piety and dedication to the cause of Islam.

In the fashion industry, Aleeyah is a common name for clothing brands and fashion lines that cater to women who want to express their femininity and confidence. In the education sector, Aleeyah is the name of several schools and universities, symbolizing the importance of knowledge and success for girls and women.
